notes: TS-1070 is a 10.1 in tabletop touch screen control panel powered exclusively via PoE+/802.3at Type 2 over its single RJ-45 port — there is no separate DC power jack or AC inlet. It has built-in speakers and microphone for intercom/voice, but these are not exposed as external audio connectors (no analog audio jacks on the unit). No HDMI, video, or other I/O is present. Not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted; it's a tabletop/optionally wall- or table-swivel-mounted unit via the optional TS-770/1070-SMK bracket). Sources: Crestron official docs — Specifications-TS-1070.htm and Features-TS-1070.htm (docs.crestron.com), part of the TS-70 Series manual.
